home.tech.title: One codebase, three databases
home.features.title: Ready on day one, not next quarter
home.features.sub: The shared plumbing of every admin system — accounts, permissions, files, monitoring, open APIs — ships with NexAdmin, and stays switchable and removable.
home.showcase.title: Three things done properly
home.showcase.sub: Permissions, the open platform, and observability are where admin systems usually stop at “supported.” Here is what they look like in a real deployment.
home.perm.head: Role permissions
home.perm.note: Permission codes reach individual buttons. Five data-scope levels are enforced server-side on reads and writes — client input is never trusted.
home.open.head: Open platform
home.open.note: Tokens, app signatures, event subscriptions, and MCP tools share one auth and rate-limit layer.
home.obs.head: Service health
home.obs.note: Four monitoring views — services, cache, APIs, and frontend errors — backed by the same data that feeds Prometheus.
home.product.title: This is the actual admin
home.product.sub: The current dashboard, not a mockup: stats, trends, and request volume come from the same system. Same dark theme as this site.
home.product.caption: Dashboard · dark theme · real data
home.intg.title: Fits the tools you already run
home.intg.sub: Sign-in, storage, alerting, and automation speak standard protocols. You don't have to replace your infrastructure.
home.market.title: Add capabilities as plugins
home.market.sub: Delivered as source: browse, download, install from the admin. Pro plugins activate as soon as the license is imported.
